name: Alligator
summary: This EA implements Bill Williams' Alligator indicator strategy for trend-following trading. It uses the three Alligator lines (Jaw, Teeth, Lips) to identify trending markets and generates entry signals when the Lips cross above or below the Teeth/Jaw. Trades are opened in the direction of the emerging trend and closed when the Alligator lines converge or flatten.
summary_zh: 该EA基于比尔·威廉姆斯的鳄鱼指标策略进行趋势跟踪交易。通过鳄鱼的三条线（颚、齿、唇）识别趋势市场，当唇线穿越齿线/颚线时产生入场信号，沿趋势方向开仓，当鳄鱼线收敛或走平时平仓。
strategy_analysis: 该策略基于比尔·威廉姆斯的鳄鱼指标，利用三条不同周期的平滑移动平均线（颚线、齿线、唇线）来判断市场趋势状态。当三条线分开时表示趋势形成，唇线向上穿越齿线和颚线时做多，唇线向下穿越时做空，这是典型的趋势跟踪入场条件。出场条件通常为鳄鱼三条线重新收敛或价格跌破/突破唇线，表明趋势结束。仓位管理方面，默认使用固定手数开仓，缺乏动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面，依赖止损和止盈参数控制单笔风险，但没有根据账户余额或波动率进行自适应调整。整体策略逻辑简单清晰，适合趋势明显的市场环境，但在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: This strategy is based on Bill Williams' Alligator indicator, using three smoothed moving averages with different periods (Jaw, Teeth, Lips) to determine market trend states. When the three lines diverge, a trend is forming; a buy signal is generated when the Lips cross above the Teeth and Jaw, and a sell signal when the Lips cross below them, which is a classic trend-following entry condition. Exit conditions typically involve the three Alligator lines converging again or price breaking below/above the Lips, signaling trend exhaustion. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size by default, lacking any dynamic adjustment mechanism based on market conditions or account equity. Money management relies on stop-loss and take-profit parameters to control per-trade risk, but there is no adaptive sizing based on account balance or volatility. The overall strategy logic is simple and clear, suitable for strongly trending markets, but it tends to generate frequent false signals in ranging or choppy markets leading to consecutive losses.

parameters.name: MA_Method
parameters.description: 移动平均方法（平滑移动平均）

pros: 策略逻辑简单直观，基于经典的比尔·威廉姆斯鳄鱼指标，易于理解和验证
趋势跟踪特性在强趋势市场中表现良好，能捕获大段趋势行情
参数可调性强，三条线的周期和偏移均可自定义以适应不同品种和时间框架
pros_en: Simple and intuitive strategy logic based on the classic Bill Williams Alligator indicator, easy to understand and verify
Trend-following nature performs well in strong trending markets, capable of capturing large trend moves
Highly configurable parameters with adjustable periods and shifts for all three lines to adapt to different instruments and timeframes
cons: 在震荡盘整市场中频繁产生虚假信号，导致连续小额亏损
固定手数仓位管理缺乏灵活性，未根据账户资金或市场波动率进行动态调整
默认止损止盈为零，存在未设止损直接交易的风险，可能导致大额亏损
缺乏新K线检查机制，可能在同一K线内重复开仓
cons_en: Generates frequent false signals in ranging or choppy markets, leading to consecutive small losses
Fixed lot sizing lacks flexibility, with no dynamic adjustment based on account equity or market volatility
Default stop-loss and take-profit are zero, creating risk of trading without protective stops which can lead to large losses
Lacks new bar check mechanism, potentially opening multiple positions within the same bar
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如ADX指标），在震荡市中减少交易频率，避免虚假信号
实现基于账户余额和ATR波动率的动态仓位管理，替代固定手数
添加新K线检查和时间间隔控制，防止同K线内重复开仓
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (such as ADX indicator) to reduce trading frequency in ranging markets and avoid false signals
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account balance and ATR volatility instead of fixed lot size
Add new bar check and time interval controls to prevent multiple position openings within the same bar

risk_points: 默认止损止盈为零，交易可能无保护性止损，面临大额亏损风险
缺乏新K线检查，可能在单根K线内多次开仓导致过度暴露
震荡市中连续虚假信号导致资金回撤累积
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss and take-profit are zero, trades may execute without protective stops, risking large losses
Lacks new bar check, potentially opening multiple positions within a single bar leading to overexposure
Consecutive false signals in ranging markets can cause cumulative drawdown
